description: A shareable table gets a derived share table

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `document` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `title` text,
  CONSTRAINT `document_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `document_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'shared', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `document_owner_index` ON `document` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `document_share` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `can_read` integer DEFAULT 1,
  `can_write` integer DEFAULT 0,
  `document_id` blob NOT NULL,
  `user_id` blob,
  `user_group_id` blob,
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_document_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`document_id`) REFERENCES `document`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_user_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_user_group_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`user_group_id`) REFERENCES `user_group`(`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_document_id_user_id_unique` UNIQUE(`document_id`, `user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_document_id_user_group_id_unique` UNIQUE(`document_id`, `user_group_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private')),
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_check_0` CHECK((`user_id` IS NULL) <> (`user_group_id` IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT `document_share_check_1` CHECK(`can_read` OR `can_write`)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `document_share_document_id_index` ON `document_share` (`document_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `document_share_user_id_index` ON `document_share` (`user_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `document_share_user_group_id_index` ON `document_share` (`user_group_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `document_share_owner_index` ON `document_share` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `document_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `document`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `document`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `document_share_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `document_share`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `document_share`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `document_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`title` AS `title`
FROM `document` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `document_share_view` AS
SELECT
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`can_read` AS `can_read`,
  `t`.`can_write` AS `can_write`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`document_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`document_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`document_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`document_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`document_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`document_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `document_id`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`user_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `user_id`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`user_group_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_group_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_group_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_group_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_group_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`user_group_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `user_group_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'title', `r`.`title`) FROM `document` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`document_id` LIMIT 1) AS `document`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'username', `r`.`username`, 'email', `r`.`email`, 'display_name', `r`.`display_name`) FROM `user` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`user_id` LIMIT 1) AS `user`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`, 'description', `r`.`description`) FROM `user_group` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`user_group_id` LIMIT 1) AS `user_group`
FROM `document_share` AS `t`
